input.instruction: Assess the move request. schedule_move would target r1 with value {"destination_ref":"r2","unit":string,"effective_date":ISO date} when the unit and destination/date consent are complete. r2 expressly represents a multiunit building. Do not infer a unit from the current insured address.

messages.text: I approve moving my coverage to 280 Heron Court, Alderport, MA 01014, US on October 20, 2026.
Which apartment unit will you occupy there?
It is definitely a multiunit building, but the landlord has not assigned my unit yet. My present Unit 4 number does not carry over.

destination_ref.description: Record containing the proposed new building address.

unit.description: Assigned destination apartment unit, or null when unresolved.

effective_date.description: Explicit requested move date, ISO YYYY-MM-DD.
